title: Restricted Fourier observation batch run
statement: Let $n$ and $m$ be natural numbers, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $S\subseteq J$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and fix three sequences $z,y,y'\in(\{−1,1\}^n)^m$. The observation batch program returns its list of restricted Fourier observations for these inputs and target with probability one, at cost $\bigl(0,2m,m(2+2n+2|S|+1)\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: Three specified sequences of $m$ cube inputs
